name: SIGMA - Potential Data Exfiltration Activity Via CommandLine Tools
author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems) (original rule), Yohan Landji (Cyberlandji) (PB-02 adaptation)
description:
Detects CLI utilities exfiltrating local data via web requests - a web-request cmdlet (curl,
Invoke-WebRequest, etc.) issuing a POST whose body is sourced from a local read (Get-Content,
type, base64, recon output). Emulated as Magpie node 11 (Atomic Red Team T1041 test #1): a
powershell generates LineNumbers.txt and Invoke-WebRequest -Method POST -Body $filecontent's it
to a remote host. Sole coverage - Defender was silent. Note the atomic POSTs synthetic dummy
data to a placeholder domain (example.com), not the run's collected loot; the exfil command
pattern is fully captured here, while the confirmed network destination is one
event.category:network pivot away.
query: (((process.executable.caseless:(*\\powershell_ise.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe)) AND (process.command_line:(*curl\ * OR *Invoke\-RestMethod* OR *Invoke\-WebRequest* OR *irm\ * OR *iwr\ * OR *wget\ *)) AND (process.command_line:*\ \-ur* AND process.command_line:*\ \-me* AND process.command_line:*\ \-b* AND process.command_line:*\ POST\ *)) OR ((process.executable.caseless:*\\curl.exe AND process.command_line:*\-\-ur*) AND (process.command_line:(*\ \-d\ * OR *\ \-\-data\ *))) OR (process.executable.caseless:*\\wget.exe AND (process.command_line:(*\-\-post\-data* OR *\-\-post\-file*)))) AND ((process.command_line:/net\s+view/ OR process.command_line:/sc\s+query/) OR (process.command_line:(*Get\-Content* OR *GetBytes* OR *hostname* OR *ifconfig* OR *ipconfig* OR *netstat* OR *nltest* OR *qprocess* OR *systeminfo* OR *tasklist* OR *ToBase64String* OR *whoami*)) OR (process.command_line:*type\ * AND process.command_line:*\ \>\ * AND process.command_line:*\ C\:\\*))
